transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the S-6. Before we finalize the communications annex this morning, I want to confirm a couple of things during our comms huddle. We have two portable relay kits available -- Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. That said, we've got exactly two sites needing kits and exactly two kits on hand, so we need to make sure equipment status is solid and there are no maintenance issues before I sign the annex and assign them. Has anyone heard anything about maintenance concerns or equipment status on either kit?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Capt. Brooks here. I need to flag something critical before we assign kits. The northern liaison site must use the approved interoperability module installed in Kit B -- Kit A cannot connect to the partner network there. I received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but this requirement has not yet been added to the communications annex. Kit B needs to go to the northern liaison site.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: SFC Tan here. I need to flag a maintenance issue on Kit B that isn't on the equipment status board yet. I verified the battery log this morning -- Kit B's installed battery pack is only certified for four hours, from 0800 through 1200. We have a replacement pack staged at the commo shop, but swapping it requires a 15-minute maintenance window at 1200. That means Kit B will have a brief service interruption at noon unless we plan for it. Given that Capt. Brooks just indicated Kit B must go to the northern liaison site, we need to account for this battery swap in the plan.
